subsections.text: BS Computer Science graduate from the University of the Philippines Diliman with hands-on experience building full-stack web applications, mobile softwarse, and video games, leveraging AI-assisted tools for rapid, documented software delivery. Proven ability to learn unfamiliar tools quickly, take ownership of systems design, and deliver maintainable products in team-based and client-facing environments. Strong foundation in scalable systems, rapid prototyping, and end-to-end development.

subsections.title: Mobile Game Designer & Developer ( Metrocycle 2.0 )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 3 | Undergraduate Thesis Project, Unity 3D, C#, Android, GitHub
items: Collaborated with 2 teammates to expand Metrocycle, a motorcycle road-safety game originally built for web.
Took ownership of a large existing codebase, learning its architecture independently to build for scalability and maintainability.
Led the Android porting effort, debugging broken systems and optimizing performance for mobile devices.
Implemented gameplay systems including avatar customization, modular minigames, weather effects, and localization.
Contributed UI/UX improvements for accessibility and clearer educational delivery.
Documented development decisions and system behavior to support future maintenance and iteration.

Presented at the Workshop on Computation: Theory and Practice (WCTP) 2025 in Hokkaido, Japan, and published the technical architecture and findings in the conference proceedings (Atlantis Press) following rigorous academic peer review.

subsections.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern ( UP FLCD éLaan )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Client-Based Internship, Agile, SvelteKit, PostgreSQL, GitHub
items: Initiated and executed a freelance-style internship with a university department to digitize its booking workflow.
Co-led agile development through sprint planning, task coordination, and regular client check-ins.
Architected and implemented the core backend system, starting from a normalized PostgreSQL database schema.
Developed dynamic, validated form workflows in SvelteKit, integrating frontend inputs with backend endpoints.
Built role-based booking flows to support different user types and request scenarios.
Rapidly learned and applied Svelte, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL to deliver a production-ready system within tight timelines.

subsections.title: Web Wrapper with Widgets for iOS & CarPlay ( LiveLyrics )
subsections.subtitle: Sole Developer | React Native, Swift, Objective-C, WidgetKit, Expo, GitHub
items: Directed Gemini 3.6 Flash to rapidly prototype, debug, and ship an end-to-end iOS application within a single week.
Architected a music web wrapper delivering real-time synced lyrics across iOS Home Screen, Lock Screen, and CarPlay widgets.
Orchestrated React Native to WidgetKit IPC using AI-assisted Swift and Objective-C bridges to shared UserDefaults.
Designed real-time DOM lyrics scraping, LRC parsing, and background playback pipelines to maintain functionalities upon lock.
Managed Expo prebuild workflows, target entitlement capabilities, and documentation for physical iPhone deployment.

subsections.title: Virtual Workspace with AI Transcription ( SyncSpace )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 4 | Project Lead, GitHub, NextJS, Supabase, Vercel, Railway
items: Conceptualized and co-developed a virtualized spatial office platform integrated with automated AI meeting transcriptions.
Stepped up as the acting technical lead, managing meeting agendas, sprint goals, and ensuring cross-functional task alignment.
Architected the system's ERD and implemented the Supabase backend infrastructure, handling relational database design, user authentication, and Google OAuth integration.
Developed custom Supabase backend functions and modular endpoint logic to bridge frontend UI states with real-time data.

Owned the project's multi-platform deployment topology, configuring continuous delivery pipelines on Vercel for the frontend and orchestrating independent backend call microservices on Railway hosting environments.

items.Web & App Development: React, NextJS, SvelteKit, Swift; Playwright; MySQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, NodeJS
items.Development Practices: Version Control (Git, GitHub), Agile Methodology, Documentation
